gmcm.enableMod.name: Enable Mod
gmcm.enableMod.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off.
gmcm.maxPerMonth.name: Max Bouquets Per Month
gmcm.maxPerMonth.tooltip: Max bouquet events per in-game season.
gmcm.randomCd.name: Random Cooldown
gmcm.randomCd.tooltip: Use a random cooldown between the configured minimum and maximum days.
gmcm.randomCdMin.name: Random Cooldown Min
gmcm.randomCdMin.tooltip: Minimum cooldown days when Random Cooldown is enabled.
gmcm.randomCdMax.name: Random Cooldown Max
gmcm.randomCdMax.tooltip: Maximum cooldown days when Random Cooldown is enabled.
gmcm.fixedCd.name: Fixed Cooldown
gmcm.fixedCd.tooltip: Cooldown length in days when Random Cooldown is off.
gmcm.rejectPenalty.name: Rejection Penalty (points)
gmcm.rejectPenalty.tooltip: Friendship lost on 'No' (250 points is 1 heart).
gmcm.minEligibleHearts.name: Minimum Eligible Hearts
gmcm.minEligibleHearts.tooltip: Minimum hearts required before an NPC can initiate a bouquet event.
gmcm.maxEligibleHearts.name: Maximum Eligible Hearts
gmcm.maxEligibleHearts.tooltip: NPCs with this many hearts or more won’t start a bouquet event.
gmcm.dailyTriggerChance.name: Daily Trigger Chance %
gmcm.dailyTriggerChance.tooltip: Chance, on each eligible day after the cooldown ends, that a bouquet event is scheduled.
gmcm.allowMale.name: Allow Male Suitors
gmcm.allowMale.tooltip: If unchecked, male NPCs won’t ask.
gmcm.allowFemale.name: Allow Female Suitors
gmcm.allowFemale.tooltip: If unchecked, female NPCs won’t ask.
gmcm.debugCmds.name: Enable Debug Commands
gmcm.debugCmds.tooltip: Enables the 'dr.*' console commands and the debug menu.
gmcm.debugMenuKey.name: Open Debug Menu Key
gmcm.debugMenuKey.tooltip: Keybind to open the Dating Reversed debug menu (only works when Debug Commands is enabled).
gmcm.status.title: Live Status
debugMenu.title: Dating Reversed
bouquet.ask.1: Hey, @... mind if we talk for a second?
bouquet.ask.2: I’ve been carrying this feeling around, and it keeps pointing at you.
bouquet.ask.3: @, every time you walk by, my heart skips. Do you notice it too?
bouquet.ask.4: The days feel brighter when we’re together. Does it feel that way for you?
bouquet.ask.5: I have a strange question for you. Have you ever pictured us as more than friends?
bouquet.ask.6: Could we talk for a moment? I need to tell you something important.
bouquet.ask.7: I’m nervous, so I’ll just say it—being near you makes me happy.
bouquet.ask.8: Whenever I see you, the world softens. Do you feel that?
bouquet.ask.9: I keep finding excuses to visit you, but this time I would like to ask you something.
bouquet.ask.10: I might blush saying this, but... you’re often on my mind.
bouquet.ask.11: I value our friendship, @, but my heart hopes for more.
bouquet.ask.12: The stars looked beautiful last night—yet I thought of your smile instead.
bouquet.ask.13: Hey, @... my day feels unfinished until we speak. Is it the same for you?
bouquet.ask.14: Would it be strange if I said you’ve become my favorite person?
bouquet.ask.15: @, every little thing you do lingers with me. Does that mean something?
bouquet.ask.16: When I imagine the future, you’re always there. Am I alone in that?
bouquet.ask.17: Talking to you is the best part of my routine. Could it become something deeper?
bouquet.ask.18: I practiced this in the mirror... Do you see me the way I see you?
bouquet.ask.19: Sometimes I catch myself smiling for no reason—then I realize it’s because of you.
bouquet.ask.20: I can’t keep pretending it’s just friendship. May I ask, do you feel the same spark I do?
bouquet.ask.21: @, I rehearsed this the whole walk over, and it still isn’t any easier.
bouquet.ask.22: Do you have a minute? There’s something I can’t keep to myself any longer.
bouquet.ask.23: I wrote you a letter last night... then lost my nerve and tore it up. So I’ll just say it.
bouquet.ask.24: Lately, every good part of my day seems to have you in it.
bouquet.ask.25: Someone in town asked why I’ve been smiling so much lately. I didn’t know how to explain that it’s you.
bouquet.ask.26: I don’t usually say things like this, @, so please bear with me.
bouquet.ask.27: You’ve changed this town since you arrived. You’ve changed me, too.
bouquet.ask.28: I picked these flowers this morning, and the whole way here I wondered if I’d have the courage.
bouquet.ask.29: Can I be honest with you? I look for you in every crowd, at every festival.
bouquet.ask.30: @, I think my heart decided something before I did.
bouquet.q.1: Would you like to be more than friends, @?
bouquet.q.2: Do you feel ready to take the next step with me?
bouquet.q.3: Could we call what we have 'dating' from now on?
bouquet.q.4: Would it make you happy if we became a couple?
bouquet.q.5: Is it okay if we say we’re officially together?
bouquet.q.6: Would you be my romantic partner from today onward?
bouquet.q.7: Shall we try sharing our days as something more than friends?
bouquet.q.8: Would you go out with me—just the two of us?
bouquet.q.9: Can our friendship grow into something romantic?
bouquet.q.10: Do you see us working as a couple, @?
bouquet.q.11: Would it be all right if we started dating?
bouquet.q.12: Could we give a real relationship a chance?
bouquet.q.13: Do you want to see where a romance between us could lead?
bouquet.q.14: Are you willing to take my hand and call this love?
bouquet.q.15: Shall we write a new chapter together—as partners?
bouquet.q.16: Would you enjoy calling what we have 'dating'?
bouquet.q.17: Are you comfortable making our bond something official?
bouquet.q.18: Could we try being sweethearts for a while?
bouquet.q.19: Would you like to share sunsets with me as more than friends?
bouquet.q.20: Is your answer 'yes' to us becoming something special?
bouquet.accept.1: $h Really? That makes me happier than I can say!
bouquet.accept.2: $h I was so afraid you’d say no—thank you!
bouquet.accept.3: $h You just turned an ordinary day into something unforgettable.
bouquet.accept.4: $h I feel like I could float right now. Let’s make this real.
bouquet.accept.5: $h My heart’s racing, but in the best possible way.
bouquet.accept.6: $h I promise I’ll treasure this chance and treat you with care.
bouquet.accept.7: $h Guess I’ll be smiling for the rest of the week!
bouquet.accept.8: $h I’ve dreamed of this moment, and it’s even sweeter in reality.
bouquet.accept.9: $h Thank you for believing in us. Let’s see where this goes.
bouquet.accept.10: $h I can’t wait to spend more time—just... us.
bouquet.accept.11: $h This feels so right. I’m excited for our next adventure.
bouquet.accept.12: $h You just made me the happiest person in Pelican Town!
bouquet.accept.13: $h Finally, I can stop hiding these feelings.
bouquet.accept.14: $h I’ll cherish this bouquet—and the promise behind it.
bouquet.accept.15: $h Let’s make memories we’ll laugh about years from now.
bouquet.accept.16: $h My cheeks hurt from smiling, but I don’t want to stop.
bouquet.accept.17: $h Who knew a single word—'yes'—could sound so beautiful?
bouquet.accept.18: $h I can’t stop thinking of all the things we’ll do together.
bouquet.accept.19: $h Thank you for trusting me with your heart. I’ll guard it well.
bouquet.accept.20: $h This is the start of something wonderful—I can feel it.
bouquet.accept.21: $h I’m going to remember this moment for the rest of my life.
bouquet.accept.22: $h I want to tell everyone... but maybe we keep it just between us for a little while.
bouquet.accept.23: $h You said yes! I’ve never been so glad to be nervous.
bouquet.accept.24: $h I think the whole valley just got a little warmer.
bouquet.accept.25: $h I’d planned what to say if you said no. I’m so glad I don’t need it.
bouquet.accept.26: $h Then it’s settled. Our first real date is on me.
bouquet.accept.27: $h I didn’t know my heart could feel this light.
bouquet.accept.28: $h Every day with you has been a good one. Now I get to call them ours.
bouquet.accept.29: $h You’ve made me braver just by saying yes.
bouquet.accept.30: $h Let’s take this one day at a time—together.
bouquet.reject.1: $s Oh... I understand. Thank you for being honest with me.
bouquet.reject.2: $s I see. Please don’t worry—I’ll be okay.
bouquet.reject.3: $s It stings a little, but I respect your choice.
bouquet.reject.4: $s No hard feelings. Our friendship still matters to me.
bouquet.reject.5: $s I appreciate your honesty. Maybe another time, another season.
bouquet.reject.6: $s I’m glad I asked, even if the answer is no.
bouquet.reject.7: $s I’ll give you space. Thank you for listening.
bouquet.reject.8: $s My heart’s a bit bruised, but I’ll heal—promise.
bouquet.reject.9: $s I value you, @, even if it’s only as friends.
bouquet.reject.10: $s Thank you for sparing my feelings with kindness.
bouquet.reject.11: $s I was hopeful, but I’ll treasure our current bond instead.
bouquet.reject.12: $s Your answer won’t change the feelings I have for you.
bouquet.reject.13: $s I’ll tuck these flowers away and keep moving forward.
bouquet.reject.14: $s It’s okay—some dreams need more time to grow.
bouquet.reject.15: $s I’d rather know the truth than wonder forever. Thank you.
bouquet.reject.16: $s We’ll keep sharing smiles, just on different terms.
bouquet.reject.17: $s I need a moment, but don’t worry—I’ll be fine.
bouquet.reject.18: $s Our paths stay crossed; they just won’t entwine right now.
bouquet.reject.19: $s I’m grateful you cared enough to answer honestly.
bouquet.reject.20: $s Take care, @. Let’s meet again with lighter hearts.
bouquet.reject.21: $s That’s all right. I’d rather have you as a friend than not at all.
bouquet.reject.22: $s I understand. Let’s pretend I never got this flustered, okay?
bouquet.reject.23: $s Oh. Well... at least now I know. Thank you for not laughing.
bouquet.reject.24: $s Some flowers bloom late. Maybe some feelings do, too.
bouquet.reject.25: $s I’ll be all right. I just need a quiet walk to clear my head.
bouquet.reject.26: $s I’m a little embarrassed, but I don’t regret asking.
bouquet.reject.27: $s Please don’t feel guilty, @. You were honest, and that matters to me.
bouquet.reject.28: $s I’ll keep these flowers anyway. They still remind me of a good day.
bouquet.reject.29: $s Friends it is, then. I meant every word, though.
bouquet.reject.30: $s Thank you for letting me say it. My heart feels lighter, even if it aches a little.
